description:
FOUND s491 (Fable, 2026-09-19) by a review probe for perf round 34; PRE-EXISTING on main 4c6565e5.  LOW priority by CLAUDE.md principle 9 (a program perl kills is not a functioning program) -- filed because the VALUE half is inconsistent, which says two code paths read `fallback` differently, and a per-class overload cache (s473x) would freeze whichever one it meets first.

REPRODUCER (probed vs perl 5.40.3): ~/pcl-agent-scratch/s491/probes/povl-fallback.pl (+ .perl.out / .main-4c6565e5.out).  Three classes, each overloading ONLY `""` => "7": F0 fallback => 0, FU no fallback key, F1 fallback => 1.
            perl            PCL
  F0 +    died            ok:2     <- 2, not 8: the object numified as 1 (a TRUE), not through its "" handler
  F0 .    died            ok:7x
  F0 eq   died            ok:T
  FU +    died            ok:8
  FU .    ok:7x           ok:7x    (undef fallback: autogeneration allowed, `.` comes from "")
  FU eq   died            ok:T
  F1 *    ok:8 / 7x / T   identical

perl RULE (perlovload "Minimal Set" + "fallback"): undef = try autogeneration, DIE if impossible; 0 = never autogenerate, DIE; 1 = autogenerate, else fall back to the un-overloaded behaviour silently.  With only a conversion operator defined, `+` and `eq` cannot be autogenerated under undef -- only under 1.

THE CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (not taken): trace which function handles `$o + 1` for F0 vs FU (`p-+` -> the overload lookup -> the numeric coercion) and read where `fallback` is consulted; the 2-vs-8 split says F0 reaches %to-number on the raw blessed box while FU reaches the `""`-then-numify path.

FIX SHAPE if taken: ONE predicate "may this class autogenerate OP from its conversions" reading the stored fallback value (three-valued), consulted at the ONE place the binary-op dispatch falls through; the DIE is perl-shaped and trappable.  Must not slow the no-overload fast path (the raw-slot / insensitive-call gates already exclude overloaded classes).  Flag in the report if it adds a per-op branch.

BAR: `cl/` change -> full sweep + op/ companion leg; guard rows in Pl/t/overload-01.t (the 9-cell table above).
subject: `use overload ... fallback => 0` (and fallback undef) never DIES for an operator with no method: PCL autogenerates from `""` where perl dies "Operation ... no method found" -- and `fallback => 0` `$o + 1` answers 2 where the undef spelling answers 8 (two internal paths disagree)
